{{Top}}
[[File:Ponda_Babas_arm.png|thumb|right|280px|An [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] arm severed by a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].]]
{{Quote|That's because droids don't pull people's arms out of their sockets when they lose. Wookiees are known to do that.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Limbs''' were important appendages of organic bodies and many types of mechanical chassis. They were typically designed for motion and/or manipulation, and were found on most [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient [[Species/Legends|species]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and many [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other artificial constructs.

==Description==
[[File:StormtrooperMarching-Empire16.png|thumb|left|250px|Stormtroopers of the Galactic Empire march in lockstep via their two legs.]]
[[Human/Legends|Humans]] and many other important sentient species were bipedal, with two legs and two arms, and this form was imitated by many droids; but there were many variations. Sometimes these were relatively subtle, especially in the construction of hands, feet and their digits.

Some bipedal species of the galaxy exhibited four arms, such as [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisks]], [[Codru-Ji]], [[Myneyrsh]]i, and [[Pho Ph'eahian]]s.

Many [[Bird/Legends|Birds]] and [[Reptavian/Legends|Reptavians]] such as [[Dactillion/Legends|Dactillions]] and [[Ibbot]]s possessed the ability of flight via the usage of specialized limbs in the form of wings often taking the form of either a feathered, membraned, or insectoid structure.

[[File:TheOnesCreatureForm-Overlords.jpg|thumb|right|250px| The [[Daughter/Legends|Daughter]] and [[Son/Legends|Son]] in their creature forms on [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]], displaying the usage of wings for flight.]]

Other species and designs, however, had limbs of more radically different designs, like the [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]] with its '''tentacles''' and prehensile [[Eye/Legends|eyestalk]], or the [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] astromech, which could travel in a bipedal or tripodal configuration, and had a wide variety of manipulator arms that could be extended from their torso and head.

Some species, such as the [[Kloodavian]]s,<ref name="Search for the Lost Jedi">''[[Episode I Adventures 1: Search for the Lost Jedi]]''</ref> [[Gand/Legends|Gands]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> were able to regrow their limbs if they were severed.

Other species, such as serpents like [[Snake/Legends|snakes]], and the sentient [[Priapulin]] had no limbs.

==History==
During the era of the [[Old Republic era|Old Republic]], [[Zeerid Korr]] once heard of technology in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] that could regenerate limbs but didn't know if he had the means to afford it.<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were known to pull limbs off individuals when unhappy.<ref name="sw4">''[[Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope]]''</ref> Some warriors, like the Jedi Knights, trained in means to sever limbs in battle, as a means of subduing an enemy without having to kill outright.<ref name="Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Some Sith used similar moves to dominate and intimidate their enemies.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back">{{Film|V}}</ref>
